svg.title: infrastructure · material · dark
svg.desc: OrderFlow worked example (dark theme). ViewBox 1660x880. Three region boundaries (group.boundary.neutral) each containing an ALB md-card, an ECS Fargate cluster card with 3 service rows, and a data tier of md-card--service-sql/cache/store cards. Cross-region async replication arrow links us-east-1 RDS to eu-west-1 RDS. Single global Snowflake card (md-card--service-slate) at bottom receives Snowpipe fan-in from all 3 regions.
svg.text: Cloud topology · 3 regions · per-region VPC with ALB → ECS → managed data tier

svg.text: Three independent VPCs · ALB → ECS Fargate → managed data tier · us-east-1 is primary; eu-west-1 carries the read replica + GDPR-resident copy.
solid info-blue = intra-region traffic · grey-dashed = cross-region async replication · slate-dashed = analytics fan-out to Snowflake
